Project description
Riders rate from the back seat and can't see why a driver stopped; telematics knows the car braked, not that a pedestrian stepped out. Dashi reviews each trip's dashcam footage and finds the moments that matter. Proactive side: kudos cards and lesson cards built from the driver's own clips, posted without being asked. Ask side: the driver says "Help me improve my rating" and Dashi finds the 3-star trip, plays the clip where they yielded to a pedestrian, and offers to send the evidence for a rating review. Footage questions in plain English ("show me pedestrians crossing in front of me") run a live VAST hybrid search. For a coachable moment (turning while a pedestrian was still crossing) Dashi shows a better way from a fixed playbook and writes an Ideal replay prompt for a Cosmos Predict/Transfer-style model to render the same scene driven safely. Every verdict quotes the camera caption word for word. Eval on 12 labelled clips: verdict 12/12, scenario 10/12, 0 false alarms; groundedness of summaries 3/7 (our weak spot). Footage is the pie_cam-3 Toronto research dashcam; ratings, routes and driver are simulated. No telemetry, so no speed or braking claims.

hasPart.name: Technical architecture
hasPart.description: Dashcam video (pie_cam-3) runs through the pre-built VAST DataEngine pipeline: YOLO11 detections, NVIDIA Cosmos Reason captions (with our custom ingest prompt so captions describe what the driver's own car does), Cosmos Embed vectors, stored in VastDB. Dashi: discover.py searches each playbook scenario with VAST hybrid search and prunes the playbook. app/core.py runs a 5-stage review per trip: gather segments, classify captions with an LLM on W&B Inference (DeepSeek V4 Flash), validate (evidence quote must be an exact substring of the caption, confidence >= 0.6), merge segments into moments, coach from the playbook, write an Ideal replay prompt, score the trip. app/analyze.py writes moments.

hasPart.name: Setup instructions
hasPart.description: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install fastapi uvicorn requests openai weave. Set INGRESS_URL, USERNAME, PASSWORD (VSS), WANDB_API_KEY, WANDB_TEAM, WANDB_PROJECT. cd app; ../.venv/bin/python ../discover.py; ../.venv/bin/python analyze.py --chunks ../candidates.txt --out ../work/candidates_review.json; ../.venv/bin/python analyze.py --assign ../work/candidates_review.json --trips trips.json; ../.venv/bin/python analyze.py --trips trips.json --out moments.json; ../.venv/bin/python ../eval/run_eval.py. Run locally: DASHI_LOCAL=1 PORT=8090 ../.venv/bin/python main.py. Deploy: deploy/deploy.sh. Full steps in README.md.

hasPart.name: Lessons learned
hasPart.description: The ingest prompt decides what you can find. Default captions describe the scene well but rarely say what the camera car itself does, so in 22 scanned chunks only one coachable moment existed, and it came from a chunk re-ingested with our custom prompt (captions saying the car yields went from 0/6 to 3/6 segments). Similarity scores alone (0.3-0.4) can't tell good hits from bad; checking captions with negated sentences removed did. Forcing the LLM's evidence quote to be an exact substring of the caption made the output trustworthy, and the eval showed the one-line summaries are still the weak spot (3/7 fully grounded). POST /search rejects llm_top_n 0 with HTTP 422, and search latency varied
